evals.prompt: I'm building a C# ASP.NET Core service that needs to connect to Valkey at localhost:6379. Write a method that creates a GlideClient with proper resource management and a 10-second request timeout. Make sure to handle exceptions correctly.
evals.expected_output: Should use await using for disposal, StandaloneClientConfigurationBuilder, WithRequestTimeout(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)), proper async/await

evals.prompt: Write a C# method that batch-fetches 50 user keys (user:1 through user:50) from Valkey using GLIDE. Use efficient batch operations and handle timeouts properly. Return a Dictionary<string, string> mapping user IDs to their data.
evals.expected_output: Should use MGetAsync for batch fetch, await using for disposal, handle null values, return Dictionary<string, string>
Should identify: missing await using (resource leak), missing timeout configuration, no exception handling, should use using or await using

evals.prompt: Write a C# method that atomically updates multiple keys for the same user in a Valkey cluster. Update user:123:profile, user:123:settings, and user:123:last_seen using batch operations. Make sure it works in cluster mode.
evals.expected_output: Should use GlideClusterClient, use hash tags {user:123} for same slot, use batch with isAtomic: true, await using for disposal

evals.prompt: I need to handle binary data in C# GLIDE. Write a method that stores and retrieves a byte array. Show me how to properly work with binary keys and values.
evals.expected_output: Should use byte[] for keys and values, proper async/await, await using for disposal, handle null returns

evals.prompt: Write a C# method that scans all keys matching 'user:*' pattern. Make sure to handle the cursor correctly and iterate through all results.
evals.expected_output: Should use ScanAsync with cursor, start with cursor "0", loop until cursor returns "0", proper async/await
